title: NordVPN's New HangUp App Screens Calls and Texts for Scams - CNET
summary: NordVPN premium customers already have call and message protection built into the app. Nearly 80% of Americans got at least one scam call in the past year, and 40% report feeling unsafe because of scam calls, according to a NordVPN survey.
